  UART_SendText("\r\nLM393 light sensor test\r\n");
  UART_SendText("\r\nWS2812 test started\r\n");

  HAL_Delay(100);

  /* Thu mau o muc sang thap */
  const uint8_t test_colors[4][3] = {
      {24,  0,  0},   /* Do */
      { 0, 24,  0},   /* Xanh la */
      { 0,  0, 24},   /* Xanh duong */
      {24, 24, 24}    /* Trang */
  };

  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 4U; i++)
  {
      if (WS_SetAll(test_colors[i][0],
                    test_colors[i][1],
                    test_colors[i][2]) != HAL_OK)
      {
          UART_SendText("WS2812 DMA failed or timeout\r\n");
          Error_Handler();
      }

      HAL_Delay(1000);
  }

  WS_SetAll(0, 0, 0);
  UART_SendText("WS2812 color test completed\r\n");
